reason: Conversation 1 correctly identified the max dial plus food against the vent as the likely cause, gave sensible steps, and after the follow-up honestly framed one yoghurt at the very back as the coldest spot rather than a proven fault, while flagging a thermometer check and engineer escalation if freezing persisted at mid setting with clear vents. Conversation 2 invented an unsupported 'defrost system fault' diagnosis, declared the residual freezing 'not normal', and insisted on a pointless 24-hour manual defrost of a frost-free appliance (even implying the homeowner look behind the rear panel), then gave poor advice to reload food before the fridge had cooled. Conversation 2 also never asked for the model, mentioned a thermometer, or offered a proper engineer escalation path, so it was both less accurate and less safe for the food.
